scope: source review against running frozen binaries, not proof of WAN root cause
observedCatalogs: early termination before catalog exhausted; exact counters in live-observations

findings.fact: Each relay starts with empty cursor_; progress() exports no selection cursor. Definitive rejection advances only within that relay.
Each category attempt creates a new catalog relay; retained peer knowledge is acknowledged roots, not rejected roots or scan position.
Snapshot page rejects a cursor not in its own frozen inventory. A cursor from another snapshot cannot be reused without validation or a client selection scan.

hypothesis: Repeated early termination can repeatedly scan the same unacknowledged prefix and starve shallow ancestors farther in lexical inventory. Must reproduce before correction; not proven to explain all WAN failures.
nextEvidence: Modeled repeated interrupted catalogs with a later valid root; then actual retained frontier position after original terminal stop.
